catalogue.error.code_taken: The code {code} belongs to another item. Codes are unique across the whole system.
catalogue.first_run.nobabs_body: Every item in the price catalogue belongs to one باب, such as concrete works or electrical works. No أبواب exist yet, so there is nothing to add an item to.
catalogue.first_run.nobabs_step_1: Create the أبواب on the أبواب screen.
catalogue.first_run.nobabs_step_2: Come back here and add the items and their prices, one by one or from an Excel file.
catalogue.first_run.noitems_body: The أبواب are ready. Add the first item by hand, or import a whole batch from an Excel file if your prices are kept in a sheet.
catalogue.first_run.noitems_step_1: “New item”: for one item or a few.
catalogue.first_run.noitems_step_2: “Import from Excel”: one batch, not an ongoing sync, with a preview before anything changes.
catalogue.import.drop_hint: An .xlsx file. The first sheet is read.
catalogue.import.drop_or: or drag the file here and drop it
catalogue.import.how_new: A row whose code is not in the catalogue: a new item with that code.
catalogue.import.how_existing: A row whose code exists: only that item's prices change, the cost price and the sell price. The description, unit and باب do not change. The preview warns you before anything changes.
catalogue.import.how_blank: A row with no code: skipped, and the preview shows why.
catalogue.import.how_batch: One batch, not an ongoing sync: nothing changes after it is applied if you edit the file.
catalogue.import.columns_note: The first row must carry exactly these headings, in these Latin spellings. An extra or a missing column refuses the file.
catalogue.import.to_notice_title: You cannot change existing prices by import.
catalogue.import.to_notice_body: You can add new items with their prices. If the file changes an existing price, the whole file is refused.
catalogue.import.parsing_title: Reading the file and checking the rows
catalogue.import.parsing_hint: Nothing in the catalogue has changed yet.
catalogue.import.file_bad_title: The file “{name}” could not be read.
catalogue.import.file_bad_hint: Check that it is an .xlsx file with the seven headings listed below, at least one data row after the heading row, and under {limit} MB. Nothing changed.
catalogue.import.stat_new_caption: Will be added with the codes in the file
catalogue.import.stat_price_caption: Existing items, found by code, whose prices change
catalogue.import.stat_error_caption: Will not be applied; fix them in the file
catalogue.import.overwrite_title: {count} existing items will have their prices changed.
catalogue.import.overwrite_body: The import is one batch, not a sync: the file is not linked to the catalogue after it is applied. Review the rows marked “Price change” before you continue.
catalogue.import.refusal_title: This import is refused for your account.
catalogue.import.refusal_body: {count} rows change an existing price. Only the Owner changes prices, and the server refuses the whole file if it holds one price change. Remove the price changes from the file and upload it again, or ask the Owner to apply it. The rows marked with a lock are the ones that change a price.
catalogue.import.refusal_body_short: {count} rows change an existing price, and only the Owner changes prices.
catalogue.import.detail_new: A new item will be added
catalogue.import.detail_same: The price in the file matches the stored price
catalogue.import.apply_summary: Will be applied: add {created}, change the price of {changed}
catalogue.import.apply_undo: An import cannot be undone once it is applied.
catalogue.import.nothing_body: The file adds no item and changes no price.
catalogue.import.dlg_body: {created} items will be added, and the price of {changed} existing items will change.
catalogue.import.dlg_body_add: {created} new items will be added to the catalogue.
catalogue.import.dlg_irreversible: The import cannot be undone. The changes are recorded in the audit trail, and there is no restore button.
catalogue.import.dlg_recoverable: The changes are recorded in the audit trail, and you can archive any added item from the catalogue.
catalogue.import.refused_nothing_changed: No item was added and no price changed: nothing in the catalogue changed.
catalogue.import.apply_failed: The import could not be applied.
catalogue.import.result_summary: {created} items were added, {repriced} were re-priced ({changed} with a price change), and {skipped} rows were skipped. Every change is recorded in the audit trail.
proof.title: Proof of numbers
proof.lede: The actual postings beside what the contract rules expect, line by line. Read-only: nothing here is corrected automatically.
proof.contract.no_value: Contract value not set yet: no signed BOQ
proof.verdict.empty.title: No postings yet
proof.verdict.empty.body: Nothing has been posted for this project, so there is nothing to compare. The comparison appears after the first posting.
proof.verdict.bad.title: The numbers do not match: {failed} of {total} checks failed, {events} events differ
proof.verdict.bad.body: Open the failed check or the shaded cell to see expected and actual together. Nothing here is corrected automatically.
proof.verdict.nocalc.title: The checks match; the line-by-line comparison is not available yet
proof.verdict.nocalc.body: All {total} contract checks hold. But the expected figures for each event are unavailable while the contract calculator is not built, so events are not judged one by one.
proof.verdict.partial.title: No final verdict yet: {matched} of {total} checks match
proof.verdict.partial.body: {waiting} checks have no verdict yet: they wait for handover or lack an input. The line-by-line comparison is unavailable while the expected figure for each event is unavailable.
proof.verdict.ok.title: The numbers match: {total} of {total} checks and every event
proof.verdict.ok.body: The actual postings equal what the contract rules expect, line by line.
proof.empty.note: The comparison needs postings. Post the first extract, then come back.
proof.checks.title: Checks
proof.check.unavailable: An input is missing: there is no signed contract value, so there is no expected figure to compare with.
proof.check.pending: It cannot be judged before handover and the hold release.
proof.check.a6: The example has no disbursement, so this check is not really exercised.
proof.check.holdIsRateOfContract.title: Hold = {rate}% of the contract
proof.check.holdIsRateOfContract.rule: Before release, the accumulated hold equals the hold rate times the contract value.
proof.check.advanceEndsAtZero.title: The advance ends at exactly zero
proof.check.advanceEndsAtZero.rule: The sum of the advance on its ledger is zero after the last extract.
proof.check.materialInEqualsOut.title: تشوينات: paid in = recovered
proof.check.materialInEqualsOut.rule: The total issued as تشوينات equals the total recovered.
proof.check.collectionEqualsContract.rul: The total received from this client equals the contract value.
proof.check.safeNeverNegative.title: The safe never goes below zero
proof.check.safeNeverNegative.rule: The lowest running safe balance across this project's postings is not below zero.
proof.events.title: Expected against actual, event by event
proof.events.calculator_missing: The expected figure for each event is not available yet: the contract calculator is not built. Expected is never inferred from the actual postings, because that would make every row match by definition.
proof.events.foot: The "Expected" row comes from the contract rules alone. The "Actual" row is summed from the ledger postings alone. Neither is used to build the other.
proof.rule.hold: Hold rate on the work value (and the release at handover)
proof.rule.advance: Recovery rate on the work value until the advance is used up
proof.rule.material: Entered: a rate at issue, then recovery in figures the accountant enters
proof.cell.unavailable_event: No expected figure for this event
proof.cell.unavailable: Unavailable: the contract calculator is not built
proof.expand.no_posting: No posting of this kind for this event
proof.ledgers.title: The five ledgers
proof.ledgers.no_total: There is no grand total of these five ledgers. On purpose.
proof.ledgers.no_total_detail: Each ledger is read alone and never netted against another.
proof.ledger.ClientAdvance.title: Client advance
proof.ledger.ClientAdvance.meaning: What we took in advance and have not yet recovered through extracts. It reaches zero and never goes below.
proof.ledger.ClientAdvance.floor: A zero floor enforced by the database
proof.ledger.Hold.title: Hold
proof.ledger.Hold.meaning: It only grows. Nothing leaves it before handover, then it is released once, in full.
proof.ledger.Hold.floor: No floor in the database: a single release at handover governs it
proof.ledger.FirmAdvance.title: Firm advance
proof.ledger.FirmAdvance.meaning: What Kaff spends on a client's behalf, with the owner's approval and a cap the system enforces.
proof.ledger.FirmAdvance.floor: The hard cap is not enforced yet
proof.ledger.PettyCashAdvance.title: Petty cash
proof.ledger.PettyCashAdvance.meaning: Cash with staff not yet settled with receipts. No new petty cash before the last is settled.
proof.ledger.PettyCashAdvance.floor: A zero floor enforced by the database
proof.ledger.OwnerCurrentAccount.title: Owner current account
proof.ledger.OwnerCurrentAccount.meaning: An owner injection is a liability repaid later; a withdrawal is either a returnable advance or a final drawing.
proof.ledger.MaterialAdvance.title: تشوينات
proof.side.cash.title: Cash in the safe from this project
proof.side.cash.note: The net of this project's postings on the safe. Not the safe's own balance, which is company-wide, and not one of the five ledgers.
proof.side.material.title: تشوينات outstanding
proof.side.material.note: Outside the five ledgers, but a balance that is recovered and must reach zero.
proof.side.unclassified.title: Unclassified
proof.side.unclassified.zero: It must stay zero. Any figure here is a posting that does not know its ledger.
proof.side.unclassified.bad: Postings between two accounts with no ledger kind: the no-netting guard does not act on them. Show them and classify them.
proof.rec.ok: Reconciled: each ledger's balance equals the sum of its postings.
proof.rec.bad: Not reconciled: a ledger's balance does not equal the sum of its postings.
proof.rec.hint: The figure is not fixed from here: the difference is shown and the ledger opened.
proof.asm.title: Assumption register
proof.asm.lede: Every figure that carries an "assumption" mark rests on a rule that is not ruled yet. Press the mark anywhere to reach its row here.
proof.asm.aria: Assumption {id}: go to the assumption register
proof.asm.col.name: Assumption
proof.asm.A1.name: When an extract posts
proof.asm.A1.open: Whether postings are created at issue, approval or collection.
proof.asm.A1.shows: The posting dates on this screen.
proof.asm.A2.name: تشوينات recovery
proof.asm.A2.open: The specification has no formula for the recovery figures.
proof.asm.A2.shows: The تشوينات column in the comparison and the "paid in = recovered" check.
proof.asm.A2.changes: Content: the figure moves from "entered" to "calculated" and gains a derivation line.
proof.asm.A5.name: Account routing of the hold, advance and تشوينات
proof.asm.A5.open: These postings may pass through an account with no ledger kind, so the no-netting guard does not act on them.
proof.asm.A5.changes: Structure: unchanged. Content: the account names.
proof.asm.A6.name: The specification example has no disbursement
proof.asm.A6.open: The sequence has no outgoing payments, so the "safe never below zero" check is not really exercised.
proof.asm.A6.changes: Content: a disbursement is added to the scenario.
proof.asm.A7.name: Balance direction of each ledger
proof.asm.A7.open: Which ledger reads "debit" and which "credit" is not decided.
proof.asm.A7.shows: The balance sign on the owner current account tile.
proof.asm.A7.changes: Content: the word beside the figure only.
proof.asm.A8.name: Where تشوينات sits among the ledgers
proof.asm.A8.open: تشوينات is not one of the five ledgers but is a balance that must be tracked.
proof.asm.A8.shows: The تشوينات box outside the five ledgers.
proof.asm.A8.changes: Structure: stays outside the strip. Content: the box only.
proof.asm.A9.name: Cap on the firm advance
proof.asm.A9.open: The hard cap is not enforced.
proof.asm.A9.shows: The limit note on the firm advance tile.
proof.asm.A11.name: Advance recovery rate and the delay penalty
proof.asm.A11.open: The rate is flagged for confirmation in the specification; the penalty is off by default.
proof.asm.A11.changes: Content: the rate and the line.
